Since EmbedController#best enqueues RetrieveTopic on user-triggered embed views, each first embed can block a Sidekiq worker on a full feed download plus N imports with no timeout, and a slow feed host delays all embed retrievals while polling is enabled. The described behavior is verifiable in the diff.

adjudication.rationale: In lib/topic_retriever.rb, perform_retrieve synchronously calls `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` whenever `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled?` is true, before falling back to HTTP fetch. `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed` does `SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` (no explicit timeout in the diff) and then iterates `rss.items.each` importing every item via `TopicEmbed.import`. This work runs inline within the `Jobs::RetrieveTopic` execution path triggered by an embed request, potentially occupying a Sidekiq worker for the duration of a full feed fetch + N imports. That’s a concrete performance/architecture concern grounded in the diff, though not a correctness defect per se.
